prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a quiet library reading room. On the left, an elderly woman with silver hair sits on a wooden chair, her posture upright and dignified. In the center, a young man in a blue hoodie leans over a large oak table, his elbow resting firmly on the surface. To the right, a librarian in a green vest stands beside a rolling cart, holding a stack of hardcover books. A brown leather satchel lies open on the floor near the young man's feet, its flap partially undone. A potted fern sits on the windowsill behind the librarian, its leaves lush and vibrant. The elderly woman is looking at the young man, creating a subtle connection across the space. The young man is pointing at a specific page in an open textbook, drawing attention to the text. There is no electronic device visible in the scene, preserving the analog atmosphere. The librarian is handing a book to the young man, completing the triangular dynamic. The five distinct entities are clearly separated by their positions and actions, forming a balanced composition within the historic interior.
